addictionPotential: 轻度成瘾，滥用潜力中等。
effectsSummary: Euphoria, laughter, dissociation, dizziness, altered perception of sound, time distortion, short duration.
dosageRemark: Effects come on very quickly and last only 1-5 minutes. Frequent use can lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.
longtermRisks: Frequent use causes vitamin B12 deficiency leading to neurological damage, numbness, weakness, and pernicious anemia.
saferUse: Take breaks between balloons to allow oxygen intake.
Supplement with B12 if using regularly.
Never inhale directly from a pressurized tank.
